pages_read.title: KEPCO reports another massive data breach (Yonhap, via The Korea Times, 22 Nov 2026)

updated.what: Added The Korea Times (Yonhap) as a source: it gives the same per-system counts and reports a separate KEPCO breach of 35,528 people disclosed a month earlier (added to the summary with an evidence quote). Summary trimmed to 75 words, and the validation note was extended.

open_leads.title: KEPCO earlier breach of 35,528 employees and partner workers (disclosed about October 2026)
open_leads.note: Yonhap mentions it only in passing; it is older than the map window unless it is already on file. The SRM breakdown (426,827 corporate representatives, 442,934 KEPCO and company employees) is not added because the article contradicts itself on which SRM fields were exposed.

notes: Korea Times reports the NIS investigation but not police. The police referral stays attributed to Dailian.
